title: dam rm request
description: What dam rm takes: an object's oid or a waiting item's hash, or the id given to dam new --id. Never both.

oid.description: An oid, or a prefix of 4 or more hex characters.

id.description: The id given to dam new --id, by the same caller and in the same session.

meta.description: The request's details, as --meta KEY=VALUE passes them: harness, session, model, effort, version or any other key.
